notes.title: Minor fixes to help you beat the Teacher!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where splitscreen could split beyond 2 players, resulting in crashes.
[*] Fixed a bug where it was impossible to score goals.
[*] Minor crowd optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: Splitscreen is fixed ! Come back and play with your homies !
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed splitscreen, players now have separated cameras.
[*] Fixed a bug where player was stuck in the result screen when playing offline.
[*] Fixed a bug where player was stuck in the hook machine when all cosmetics where unlocked.
[*] Fixed a bug where mobs where stuck in the level.
[*] Fixed items disapearing animations.
[*] Fixed other minor issues.
[/list]
